= Spec tests =
- Requires that the application is in good unit-testable state, including user interactions, and preferably even UI layout/interaction.
- Be in read-only "spec session"
- I describe the intended behaviour
- LLM generates a test file
- I review and comment on test file until I accept it fulfills my request
- The file is committed (probably on feature branch)
- New session is started with the same feature request and discussion context, but the test file is read-only
- Implement until feature is implemented and test (or tests) pass
  - or LLM says there is some major blocker
